modules.module_title: Introduction to Industry and Job Role & Automotive — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Understand the history and evolution of Tyre Management Industries, including the services offered, their origin, and current market position
Analyze the challenges and opportunities facing Tyre Management Industries in the current business environment, and suggest strategies for addressing them
Understand the key responsibilities of a Service Engineer in the Tyre Management Industry, including KRA (Key Result Areas) and KPIs (Key Performance Indicators)

Maintain environmental and sustainability best practices in the workplace.
Select and apply appropriate tools and measuring equipment.
Apply knowledge of petrol and diesel engine operation.
Check and maintain batteries and jump-start vehicles as needed.
Adhere to best practices for selecting and using measuring equipment in the workplace.
